subject: Dedicated capacity sizing: brief recap & requested inputs
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Amelie Price <amelie@skylinehealth.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing: brief recap & requested inputs

Hi Amelie —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick written recap from our discovery so we have a shared baseline and a short list of items we need to lock in to produce a Dedicated proposal.

Key notes from the call:
- Primary workload: real-time clinical triage assistant for patient intake (inference per call).
- Peak TPS target: ~120 requests/sec (short spikes to ~170 for <5 minutes).
- Typical prompt token mix: 120 tokens input / 300 tokens output average.
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for interactive flows.
- Data requirements: PHI-in-scope, so customer needs Private VPC or Dedicated with strict networking and SOC2 evidence.

Deployment options discussed and preliminary guidance:
- Hosted (fastest): good for evaluation but not acceptable for PHI without VPC/private tenancy.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): likely the right tradeoff for predictable throughput + data isolation.
- Private VPC/on-prem: considered for long-term compliance if Skyline’s security team requires dedicated control plane.

Sizing items we still need from you to finalize the Dedicated estimate:
1) Traffic profile CSV with timestamps for a representative week (spikes and troughs).
2) Percent of requests that require the full 300-token response vs short responses (e.g., 50 tokens).
3) Any hard SLAs for throughput/availability beyond the latency target.

What we will deliver after we receive the above:
- GPU flavor recommendation (A100 vs H100 vs L4-style options, with cost/latency tradeoffs).
- Concurrency and KV-cache configuration recommendations.
- A simple PPT with projected monthly token costs, expected p95 latency, and a recommended Dedicated pool size + autoscaling/burst plan.

Low friction next steps: if you can drop a CSV of 7 days of traffic (timestamp,tps,avg_input,avg_output) we can produce a first-draft estimate within 48 hours. I’ve cc’d Priyom and Vanessa to help with the traffic template and the estimate.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: none in this message (I requested a traffic sample).

From: Amelie Price <amelie@skylinehealth.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 17:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing: brief recap & requested inputs

Hi Sean —

Appreciate the clear recap. Attaching a sanitized sample of traffic from last week (timestamps are in UTC). A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- About 25% of calls are follow-ups where the assistant returns a short confirmation (~40 tokens). The other 75% are full triage responses (~300 tokens).
- We do see consistent daily spikes between 09:30–10:15 PT when intake centers open.
- SLA: internal target is 99.9% availability, and clinical ops would like p95 under 350ms.

I attached traffic_samples.csv. We can redact additional fields if needed for compliance, but the traffic shape is what you asked for.

Also, our security team asked whether Redwood can support an HSM-backed KMS key for encryption-at-rest and whether you offer an air-gapped option for initial onboarding (they said to flag this early).

Thanks —
Amelie Price
Product Ops, Skyline Health
amelie@skylinehealth.ai

Attachments: traffic_samples.csv

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Amelie Price <amelie@skylinehealth.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing: brief recap & requested inputs

Amelie —

Perfect, thanks for the CSV and the clarifications. A few immediate notes and our ask while Priyom and I run the modeler:

Preliminary guidance (quick, high-level):
- GPU flavor: H100 family gives best latency headroom at 300+ token outputs for p95 < 300ms in our benchmarks; A100 can be cost-effective if you’re willing to accept slightly higher p95. L4-style accelerators are attractive for throughput but may struggle to meet p95 with 300-token responses.
- Concurrency: plan for 6–10 concurrent inferences per GPU for H100 (depends on batching); A100 might need a lower concurrency target (3–6) for the same latency.
- KV cache: we recommend prefix caching for repeated prompts (expected 10–20% hit rate given your use-case) — that will reduce per-token compute and improve p95.

Actions we’ll take in the next 48 hours:
1) Priyom will run the traffic CSV through our sizing model and produce a proposed Dedicated pool (GPU count + flavor) with burst and autoscale knobs.
2) Vanessa will draft a short compliance note that addresses HSM/KMS support and steps for a VPC/private onboarding.
3) I’ll ship a redwood-poc-estimate-v2.xlsx with cost buckets and expected p95 curves for H100 vs A100.

Questions for Skyline:
- Do you have a preferred cloud region (us-west1 / us-central1) for the initial deployment? Latency differences can change the GPU count by ~10–20%.
- Any blackout windows for rolling upgrades or maintenance we should be aware of?

I’ve attached the estimate workbook (draft) for visibility — still a working doc. If any of the slack in our assumptions is non-starter, call it out and we’ll re-run.

Best —
Sean

Attachments: redwood-poc-estimate-v2.xlsx

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity sizing: brief recap & requested inputs (Skyline Health)

Forwarding Skyline’s traffic sample and their follow-ups. Top-level asks for us:
- Run the CSV through the sizing model and return: 1) recommended GPU flavor and count for sustained vs peak; 2) suggested concurrency targets; 3) expected monthly token cost at 95/99 percentile usage.
- Draft a one-page compliance note confirming HSM/KMS support and options for Private VPC vs Dedicated tenancy. Security will escalate if we do not provide HSM detail.

Timeline: can we get the sizing worksheet + compliance note by EOD Wednesday (48 hours)? Priyom — can you own the sizing output? Vanessa — can you own the compliance write-up and include any steps to support an air-gapped onboarding?

Thanks —
Sean
